items.problem: `open-game-works-core/skills/server-core/SKILL.md:127` requires content hooks to run in `with_hook_change_source` with the change source of the purchase, and no shop test checks this for `validate_shop_purchase` or `on_shop_bought`. Only `server/core/shop/tests/extra.test.ts:18` reads `ctx.hook_change_source`, and only for `grant_shop_extra`. In a temporary clone, calling both hooks without `in_source` (`server/core/shop/index.ts:234`, `:270`) left all 45 shop tests passing on SQLite. A copy of that clone failed 37 of 45 tests in a control run that also inverted `on_sale`, so these runs do execute the changed code. It existed before the range.

`open-game-works-core/skills/server-core/modules/shop.md:64` purchase order step 7 sets `once_key` `shop:<request ID>`, and no shop test checks it. `grep` for `once_key` over `server/core/shop/tests/*.test.ts` finds no assert on it. In the same temporary clone, passing an empty `once_key` at this line left all 45 tests passing, because `idempotency` answers the resend in `server/core/shop/tests/buy.test.ts` before the handler runs. It existed before the range.

`open-game-works-core/skills/server-core/modules/shop.md:62` purchase order step 5 sets the cost `ref` to the decimal string of the product ID value, and the test checks only `source` of the cost `ItemChange`. In the same temporary clone, passing an empty `ref` at `server/core/shop/index.ts:240` left all 45 tests passing. It existed before the range.

`open-game-works-core/skills/server-core/modules/shop.md:109` and `:110` set `INTERNAL` for a failure of `preview_add_items` and of `grant_or_mail`, and no test goes through either path. In a temporary clone, returning `pass` for a failed preview at this line, and accepting a failed `grant_or_mail` at `server/core/shop/index.ts:254` while answering `INTERNAL` for `AlreadyApplied`, left all 45 tests passing on SQLite. `open-game-works-core/skills/server-core/modules/mailbox.md:124` says the caller treats `AlreadyApplied` as granted, so that branch is also untested. It existed before the range.

The order of steps 1 to 3 of the purchase order at `open-game-works-core/skills/server-core/modules/shop.md:58` has no test. In a temporary clone, moving the checks at lines 224 to 228 to the order limit, requirement, sale condition, request left all 45 tests passing on SQLite. With that order, a product that is both outside its window and at `limit_count` answers `SHOP_LIMIT_REACHED` instead of `SHOP_PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE`. The wrong answer was read from the code, not run. It existed before the range.
